name: Apart Burgblick
beschreibung: The Apart Burgblick in Ladis is a holiday apartment situated in a quiet location on the edge of the village with views of Laudegg Castle. The accommodation features a kitchen, a living area, and bedrooms. A balcony with outdoor seating offers panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. The location allows direct access to hiking trails and the ski areas of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis. Grocery stores and restaurants are within walking distance. The apartment is designed for self-catering guests. A wide range of outdoor activities is available throughout both summer and winter.
